address: Teşvikiye Mahallesi, Akkavak Sokak No:36, Şişli, Istanbul, 34365, Türkiye
bio: The never-ending hustle and bustle of the lively Nişantaşı neighbourhood is what characterises this cosy establishment. Istanbulites and international guests alike stream in all day long, whether for a quick bite or an extended meal with friends. Genuine Turkish hospitality and great value for money are the biggest draws of Sade Beş Denizler Mutfağı. Authentic Anatolian specialities such as spicy beef tongue salad with chilli, and lamb-filled manti cooked in a fragrant broth infused with mint and lemon juice are celebrated here with the generosity you would expect. No fuss, just rich flavours you won't be able to get enough of.
